_about: Meaning, unit and kind of each signal column, in CSV header order (source_row and timestamp are not signals). Meaning and unit come from the UCI page as supplied by the owner; null means not supplied yet, never filled from memory. kind comes from the data (PLAN.md decision 2). Every entry stays verified:false until the owner confirms it.
kind_basis: on_off = exactly two distinct values, 0.0 and 1.0, over the whole CSV (explore_data.py, step 1.3b); continuous = any other column. Owner's rule, 2026-10-19.

TP2.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

TP3.meaning: pressure generated at the pneumatic panel (system pressure the train uses)
TP3.source: UCI page variable table, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

H1.meaning: pressure from the drop when the cyclonic separator filter discharges
H1.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

DV_pressure.meaning: pressure drop when the air-dryer towers discharge; zero means the compressor is under load
DV_pressure.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Reservoirs.meaning: downstream pressure of the reservoirs, close to TP3
Reservoirs.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Oil_temperature.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Motor_current.meaning: motor current; states: about 0 A off, 4 A offloaded, 7 A under load, 9 A starting
Motor_current.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

COMP.meaning: electrical signal of the air intake valve; active when there is no air intake (compressor off or offloaded)
COMP.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

DV_eletric.meaning: signal controlling the compressor outlet valve; active when under load. Name note: CSV spelling; the page says "DV electric"
DV_eletric.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Towers.meaning: which air-drying tower is in use (inactive = tower 1, active = tower 2)
Towers.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

MPG.meaning: starts the compressor under load when pressure drops below 8.2 bar
MPG.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

LPS.meaning: activates when pressure drops below 7 bar
LPS.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Pressure_switch.meaning: detects discharge in the air-drying towers
Pressure_switch.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Oil_level.meaning: active when the oil is below expected values
Oil_level.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Caudal_impulses.meaning: counts pulses of air flowing from the APU to the reservoirs
Caudal_impulses.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19
